trickyParts: Separation rather than reservation was the reviewer's proposal and the architect's ruling, and I took it without arguing it back: the collector's names are a set that grows, and the growth is always a later commit. The evidence for that is inside this change — legionClaim's three prefixes, which missed the fourth claim name this change itself introduced.
The unchecked commands are a separate defect from the collision and had to be fixed either way: separation removes the collision, it does not make an unchecked command checked.

record_pair's writes were the same defect one checkpoint over: errexit is off inside a function called as `record_pair || fail …`, so a failed write still set pair_recorded=1 and returned 0. The class search found it; the two line numbers in the review would not have.
deviations: The daemon-controller copy keeps its path under transcripts/ rather than moving under pods/: it is a harness-owned directory, which is what the separation is for, and moving it would have put a collector name back among the derived ones.
The delta merge of main was taken immediately before the push, with main 9 commits ahead and no conflict, so the checks quoted here are at the pushed head rather than at an earlier one.
openQuestions: Stage 4b is repaired and has run at no head at all. This change rewrote its parked, released and lifecycle assertions, its delete log line and its whole transcript reader, and every reading of that harness has found a defect in it — six readings, six defects, no runs. That is the sentence the body now carries, beside the two behaviours provable only on a cluster.
Stage 4a's inverted checks are still unrun; the runner's revised list, marking each of 65 rows changed or unchanged, is a comment on the pull request.
shellcheck is not installed in this pod, so the scripts have bash -n and bunx biome check only.
discoveredComplexity: A reserved-name list is an enumeration over a set that grows, and the growth is someone else's later commit. Separating the two namespaces closes the class with no list and nothing to remember; this change contains both the defect and its own counter-example.

A fix can leave its own blind spot in the one place it did not reach. Round 6 made session_copy's refusals reach the verdict and left the collector's own two commands unchecked, so the exact failure the fix was for survived one line below it.
errexit is off inside a function called as `f || fail`, so every write in such a function needs its own check. Four writes in record_pair reported a pair recorded that was not.
